prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 3 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 2 significant wins (+11.6%, +7.3%), while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-11.0%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
sign_in, hint changes showed no clear effect across both tested iterations (-1.0% and -0.1%).
sign_in, reorder changes remain inconsistent across 2 tests, producing 1 significant win (+12.3%) and 1 significant loss (-7.1%).
Predictions remain inaccurate overall by overestimating weak ideas and underestimating big wins, and evidence is still thin for kinds of change with only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, hint: +3.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -5.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

- choose_path, redesign: +3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +4.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

- home, wait_info: +2.4% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet First Gesture Guided Flow: Adds an interactive step-by-step gesture practice flow directly on the final welcome screen, guiding users on how to pat, summon, and interact with their pet. (why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion on how to control or talk to the pet, and past lessons show finish new_flow changes deliver strong conversion wins (+11.6%, +7.3%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Care Tips and Desktop Trait Countdown Info: Displays dynamic pet care tips alongside an estimated timer and progress bar on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate. (why: The waiting step has high median/mean duration (201s / 2336s). Lessons demonstrate that wait_info changes on home reliably improve completion (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%).)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split View Story and Companion Selection Layout: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a two-column split layout showing path descriptions alongside animated pet trait previews. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s; a split layout provides immediate visual context to speed up decision-making confidence.)
3: [adoption, layout] Pet Selection Spotlight Cards Layout: Changes the pet selection list in pick_friend to a spotlight layout focusing on one pet card at a time with prominent trait badges. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion (66.8%). A clean spotlight layout reduces choice overload without altering structural flow.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Benefits Banner Notification: Adds an inline notification banner on the sign-in screen confirming that sign-in backs up pet progress and prevents profile resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account protection transparency critical.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Hide and Show Quick Action Guided Flow: Adds an interactive micro-flow on home_intro demonstrating how to hide the pet to the system tray and recall it instantly. (why: Multiple support emails cited confusion about hiding, showing, or finding the pet on desktop after setup complete.)
6: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Pet Readiness Status Indicator: Replaces static wait text on the waiting screen with a real-time multi-step progress indicator showing pet model loading status. (why: The waiting step experiences long drop-off times; real-time system status indicators give reassurance that asset rendering is active.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] First Companion Selection Progress Badge Header: Adds a progress counter and completion milestone badge to the top header of the story screen. (why: Provides immediate visual momentum early in onboarding, helping bridge the gap between initial app launch and path selection.)
8: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Finalization Assurance Copy: Updates the adoption certificate text to emphasize that pet traits and account details are stored safely before proceeding. (why: Reduces dropout at adoption_certificate (66.8% conversion) by assuring users their custom pet selections are locked in.)

scores.note: Proven finish/new_flow pattern addressing reported post-onboarding gesture confusion.
Reliable wait_info strategy targeting high wait times on home step.
Redesign showed early positive signal (+3.4%), but redesigns carry execution risk.
Targets highest drop-off step (adoption), but layout changes on adoption have mixed history.
Strong evidence from support emails, but sign_in notifications consistently underperform.
Directly resolves reported hide/show confusion using successful finish/new_flow type.
Proven wait_info pattern providing status reassurance during long rendering wait times.
Low cost incentive addition to choose_path, though evidence for incentives remains thin.
Targets adoption drop-off, but previous adoption copy changes produced negative lift.
